name: Electronic Patient Record
summary: Open-source electronic patient record software: a safe, append-only, audited longitudinal patient record with FHIR R4 as both data model and API, and explainable patient identity matching. A Rust matcher library, a Rust service (loco.rs, PostgreSQL) and a SvelteKit 3 / Svelte 5 UI, specified in spec/. Pre-release scaffold (milestone M0): NOT FOR CLINICAL USE; do not enter real patient data; no accreditation, certification or clinical validation is claimed.
status: pre-release scaffold (M0); not for clinical use

stack.matcher: Rust library (pure, deterministic, explainable identity matching), published as electronic-patient-record-matcher
stack.service: Rust, loco.rs (Axum, SeaORM), PostgreSQL 18, REST and FHIR R4

notes: The specification in spec/ and each project's spec/index.md is the source of truth; code and docs follow it. A behavioural change is one commit with a spec edit, a code edit and a test edit.
One item, one commit, one push, then look at CI. Stage named files, never `git add -A`.
Say plainly what is not built or not tested: every CHANGELOG.md entry states what was not done or not verified. Never weaken a guard or census test to get green.

Clinical risk: a change that could alter what a clinician sees, decides or signs updates governance/clinical-safety/hazard-log.csv in the same commit. Never set a hazard to accepted or closed; only the Clinical Safety Officer does.
The clinical record is append-only: no delete path for clinical data. Absent evidence is null with a reason, never zero; a missing field blocks an automatic patient link.
API versioning is the Accepts-version request header on the unversioned /api path, never /api/v1. Use Podman, not Docker.
Translations are machine-written until a speaker reviews them. Never claim a translation is reviewed.
Never put real patient data in examples, tests or fixtures; use synthetic data.

commands.matcher: cd electronic-patient-record-matcher-with-rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test
commands.service: cd electronic-patient-record-service-with-rust && cargo fmt --check && cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings && cargo test
commands.service database tests: TEST_DB_PORT=5543 TEST_REDIS_PORT=6390 podman compose -f compose.test.yaml up -d --wait, then DATABASE_URL=postgres://loco:loco@localhost:5543/electronic_patient_record_test cargo test -- --ignored --test-threads=1
commands.ui: cd electronic-patient-record-ui-with-svelte && pnpm run check && pnpm exec vitest run && PW_PORT=4183 CI=true pnpm exec playwright test
commands.docs: python3 scripts/check-links.py . && sh scripts/generate-status.sh --check && python3 scripts/generate-llms.py --check && python3 scripts/check-hazard-log.py
